description: A numeric reading of a subject at an instant: the firewall's gauges, sampled rates. Several providers may be active at once. Each stores its readings into its own table (the insight plugin's plugin_insight.measurement_sample, ADR 0020 wave 4). A reading that did not answer is named in the result's detail, never written as a zero. A provider may declare a live pass, run at its live cadence while somebody looks at a live figure, answering rows stamped with that cadence.

cadences.basis: Survey, data source 3, "Sustainable polling frequency": 300 s is the finest resolution at which the firewall keeps per-source data and the retention of that resolution is one hour. The verified section turns that from a cache cadence into a sampling cadence -- /api/diagnostics/traffic/top is a live snapshot and nothing upstream answers for a past window, so this interval is the resolution of opnview's own per-pair history rather than a refresh rate. internal/store/samples reads the same row to bound a current rate.
